title: Headphones with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- headband -->
  <path d="M20 55 Q20 15 50 15 Q80 15 80 55" fill="none" stroke="#7fd0ff" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- headband highlight -->
  <path d="M26 50 Q26 22 50 22 Q74 22 74 50" fill="none" stroke="#c9ecff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- left ear cup -->
  <rect x="10" y="45" width="22" height="34" rx="10" fill="#ff9d5c"/>
  <rect x="14" y="49" width="14" height="26" rx="7" fill="#ffc79e"/>
  <!-- right ear cup -->
  <rect x="68" y="45" width="22" height="34" rx="10" fill="#ff9d5c"/>
  <rect x="72" y="49" width="14" height="26" rx="7" fill="#ffc79e"/>
  <!-- face panel -->
  <rect x="30" y="35" width="40" height="40" rx="14" fill="#ffd94a"/>
  <rect x="34" y="39" width="32" height="32" rx="11" fill="#fff0a8"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="52" r="4" fill="#3b3b8f"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="52" r="4" fill="#3b3b8f"/>
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="50.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="50.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M41 60 Q50 69 59 60" fill="none" stroke="#3b3b8f" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="61" r="3" fill="#ff8fa3"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="61" r="3" fill="#ff8fa3"/>
</svg>
